comment: A filter asks the canvas size and may write past the layer. The kaleidoscope's run reads ctx.canvas_size() for its centre and passes SaFilterContext.WRITES_CANVAS to neighbourhood_pass, where it measured the canvas through a margin of 1 << 20 and cast ctx.point to SaNeighbourhoodPass to set where the pass writes. Two strokes are painted as in the R4 scenario and Filter > Kaleidoscope opens, the dial at 34 degrees and the Mirrors row at twelve, the centre left at the middle of the canvas. The preview is shot and the filter applied. The fold lays the stroke's orange on (1232, 720) and (1345, 573), where the layer held no paint before, and leaves (1345, 507) empty, so the centre is the middle of the canvas the context answered. Run on the integration branch before the row, the same file reads the same texels and byte for byte the same shots.
